idea-plugin.name: SVG Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
SVG Toolkit - Find, inspect, edit, preview, and export SVG graphics in IntelliJ IDEA.

Core Features

  • Embedded SVG Detection - Finds data:image/svg+xml URIs in text-based files and displays gutter previews
  • Multiple URI Encodings - Decodes standard and URL-safe Base64, URL-encoded, and plain SVG data URIs, including missing Base64 padding
  • Project SVG Browser - Search standalone .svg files by name or folder; browse thumbnails, file sizes, dimensions, and project-relative paths
  • Open Existing SVGs - Open a standalone SVG from the Project View context menu or the project browser
  • Source Editor and Live Preview - Edit formatted SVG source and see a debounced preview without automatically modifying the original
  • Save and Export - Save changes to an opened standalone SVG, save a new SVG or PNG, or copy the preview as PNG or the SVG as a Base64 data URI
  • Preview Layout and Controls - Use split, source-only, or preview-only layouts; zoom, fit, view at 1:1, and toggle checkerboard or grid overlays
  • Background Rendering and Caching - Render off the UI thread and cache gutter images to keep editing responsive
  • Configurable Inline Size - Set the size threshold for inline SVG previews (default 200 KB)

The project browser searches standalone SVG files; it does not index embedded data URIs.
